hooks.text: 扮演掠夺领主削弱王国，成为英雄队伍必须面对的最终Boss
hooks.excerpt: Build up your influence in the kingdoms by undermining their political and economic power. Lead an army of followers in spectacular turn-based combat against powerful heroes. Conquer territories in search of a powerful artifact that can shape the world. Make your enemies tremble: be the final boss they must face!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 混编不同阵营战士，并用命令与神器补足阵容优劣
hooks.excerpt: Combine warriors from different factions to consolidate their strengths and weaknesses. But your power doesn’t end there: you will have Orders and artifacts at your disposal.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 劫掠土地扩充国库，再用财富升级或招募军队
hooks.excerpt: Raze and pillage enemy lands, and take their gold for yourself. Use that wealth to upgrade your warriors’ stats, or hire more of them.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
